Job Title: TMF Associate

Employment Type: Full time, Permanent

Job Reports To: Manager, TMF Operations

Department/Unit Name: TMF Operations

Job Summary:

Responsible for the management of the Trial Master File (TMF) content and associated processes during the study life cycle from study set up to transfer/archiving. Work in partnership with study teams during periodic file reviews and audits to address findings related to the TMF. Manage access and organization of the controlled electronic file repository, in line with the defined file structure and access management framework. Work proactively and successfully within a cross-functional team. Communicate and promote department and company goals and practices. Interact with stakeholders in a way that fosters a positive working atmosphere and encompasses a professional and helpful attitude. Time allocated may be adjusted based on need.

Positions Available: 2; Note this position is cross-listed in multiple countries.

Service Delivery

  • Serve as the primary TMF contact for assigned studies.
  • Ensure TMF is complete and “inspection ready” throughout study lifecycle and documents are filed contemporaneously.
  • Work with Team Lead to create study specific TMF management and oversight documents (e.g., File Index, Expected Document Lists and TMF Management Plan) in alignment with study.
  • Develop and maintain study-specific work instructions, as needed.
  • Utilize organization skills to maintain a quality control schedule and perform periodic inventories of study TMF to ensure completeness.
  • Review and communicate out-of-scope and/or incomplete documents to study teams; escalating as needed.
  • Reconcile expected document lists based on study events and milestones.
  • Prioritize and resolve TMF help desk tickets; may include triaging activities.
  • Provide study specific TMF training to internal and/or external stakeholders, as needed.
  • Process and review documents, following applicable scanning and best practices and best practices, and applying ALCOA principles appropriately.
  • File and retrieve TMF documents in a timely manner.

Department Support

  • Complete routine administrative tasks in a timely manner (e.g., timesheets, metrics).
  • Participate in discussions, decisions and sharing of knowledge in department meetings, periodic presentations, and smaller working groups.
  • Seek opportunities to assist in the development, implementation and maintenance of internal systems (e.g., databases used to manage records).
  • Provide mentorship and training to junior level staff.
  • Propose suggestions and work on the development and maintenance of department quality system documents to improve efficiencies.

Qualifications

  • The successful candidate will possess a college diploma/degree and 1-3 years of relative related experience or on going training. They will have an understanding of TMF organization, implementation, and archival including relevant regulations and guidance to assure quality and integrity of TMFs. Have the ability to incorporate the principles of ALCOA in relation to TMF oversight. Utilize skills in time management and problem-solving. Identify challenges and problems and take the initiative to identify solutions. Demonstrated computer literacy, proven functional knowledge of Microsoft packages and potential to develop.

Working Conditions

  • - Home based, with the ability to go into office occasionally if needed.
  • *Accommodations for persons with disabilities are available on request in respect of all aspects of the recruitment and selection lifecycle. Requests can be directed to recruitment@alimentiv.com

Warning

  • PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Alimentiv is aware of the continued increase of phishing scams, leveraging various methods of attack via email, text, voice and social media. Please note that Alimentiv only uses company email addresses, which contain “@alimentiv.com”, to communicate with candidates via email. If you are contacted by someone about an open job at Alimentiv, please verify the domain of the sender’s email address and that they are asking you to apply on this website. If you believe you’ve been a victim of a phishing scam, please contact your local government cyber authority to report.

Compensation

Additional Information

We are seeking a strategic community management professional to join our International Community Team, and lead a growing team in EMEA. As the Manager of Community for EMEA, you will spearhead the development and execution of the community strategy that supports Reddit’s growth in the region.

In this role, you will lead a team of Community Specialists and will take charge of defining the roadmap for community activation and moderation across focus markets, and help develop our international playbook.

Your work will focus on experimenting, iterating, and refining processes that drive community engagement at scale. The insights you generate through these efforts will accelerate Reddit’s growth in EMEA, and serve as a model for other emerging markets. This role reports to the Director, International Community.

Responsibilities:

  • Craft and champion the regional community strategy, ensuring alignment with overall team and business goals.
  • Drive the iteration, innovation, and scaling of the community and moderator growth playbook, proactively identifying new opportunities and launching bold initiatives in key markets.
  • Inspire and empower regional teams to execute impactful programs that elevate local communities, and their markets. Encourage innovation and create an environment of continuous learning and improvement.
  • Recruit, onboard, and train local community specialists in key markets to strengthen our collaboration with moderators and drive community engagement.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Growth, Product, Engineering, etc.) to ensure successful alignment and execution of new initiatives.
  • Gather regional insights and learnings, and effectively report results to various internal stakeholders.
  • Lead, coach and develop the regional team; translate strategy into quarterly and sprint priorities, clear ownership and milestones; review risks and capacity, and unblock delivery
  • Own community-health and growth outcomes across priority markets, including KPI progression, moderator coverage and retention, and the impact of community-building initiatives.
  • Coordinate with Content, Growth, Product and relevant safety partners to deliver market initiatives and surface local needs for broader roadmap decisions.

Required qualifications:

  • 5-7 years of experience in community management or marketing operations, including at least 1-2 years in a leadership role, with a proven track record of driving community growth and delivering business impact through community-led or marketing projects.
  • Organized with a strong ability to balance strategic thinking with operational execution.
  • Problem-solver with excellent interpersonal skills, capable of collaborating with diverse cross-functional teams and influencing them to adopt a community-first mindset.
  • Comfortable testing, iterating, and adjusting strategies to find the optimal approach for each market.
  • Skilled at navigating ambiguous environments and experimenting with different approaches to achieve results in focus markets.
  • Data-driven and results-oriented, with a keen ability to translate insights into action.
  • Deep understanding of Reddit’s unique identity, and the critical role communities and moderators play in adding value to the platform and enhancing user experiences.

Bonus Points

    • Experience in moderation on Reddit or similar platforms (e.g., Discord, Facebook, or other forums).

jobs.jobDescription:
Alimentiv is a global CRO with a singular focus: advancing therapies for patients with gastrointestinal diseases. GI is our WHY and for more than 30 years that purpose has driven our scientific rigour, operational excellence, and deep therapeutic expertise, including supporting more than 70% of IBD compounds in development.
We operate as a private, profit-with-purpose company, channeling our commercial success back into scientific research, technology, and our people. With approximately 700 people across multiple countries and three service lines, we are growing deliberately, and the capability of our leaders and our organization is central to how we get there.

If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives — we want to meet you!

Job Overview

The Senior Clinical Research Associate (Sr. CRA) independently performs, coordinates and oversees clinical site monitoring activities, ensuring compliance with study protocols, Alimentiv and sponsor procedures, ICH-GCP guidelines and local regulatory requirements.

Serving as a primary liaison between investigative sites, Alimentiv and sponsors, the Sr. CRA plays a key role in the successful execution of clinical studies from site selection and start-up through monitoring and close-out. This role also provides guidance and mentorship to CRA I and CRA II colleagues and may participate in CRA assessment visits, co-monitoring activities, audits and inspections.

Key Responsibilities

  • Independently conduct and document onsite and remote site management activities, including site qualification, initiation, monitoring and close-out visits, in accordance with applicable SOPs and study requirements.

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for investigative sites, building effective working relationships and ensuring site questions, issues, action items and protocol deviations are followed through to resolution.

  • Review source documentation and study systems to ensure clinical data is accurate, complete and compliant with protocol, regulatory and study requirements; manage and facilitate the resolution of data queries.

  • Oversee site activation and ongoing site management activities, working with sites and cross-functional teams to achieve project timelines, milestones and recruitment objectives.

  • Ensure site personnel are appropriately trained on study protocols, plans, systems, ICH-GCP requirements and project-specific expectations.

  • Routinely review Investigator Site Files (ISF), Trial Master Files (TMF) and study systems for accuracy, completeness, timeliness and compliance, requesting outstanding documentation as required.

  • Coordinate site-related study activities and communications, including clinical supplies, investigational product, laboratory materials, ePROs, study documentation and ongoing project updates.

  • Collaborate with Study Start-up, Regulatory and other cross-functional teams, including supporting document collection, localisation and translation activities where required.

  • Participate in study meetings, Investigator Meetings, audits and inspections, supporting issue resolution and implementation of corrective actions when required.

  • Mentor and support CRA I and CRA II colleagues, including CRA Assessment Visits, co-monitoring and sign-off activities; contribute to CRA interviews, training and process improvement initiatives as requested.

Skills & Qualifications

  • (Honours) Bachelor’s degree required; a degree in Health Sciences, Life Sciences, Pharmacy or Nursing is preferred. A Master’s degree is considered an asset.

  • Minimum 4–6 years of relevant clinical research experience; 7–9 years of related experience is preferred.

  • Experience across Phase I–IV clinical trials is preferred.

  • Thorough knowledge of ICH-GCP and applicable local regulatory requirements.

  • Demonstrated experience independently conducting site qualification, initiation, monitoring and close-out visits.

  • Proficiency with clinical trial systems including EDC platforms (e.g., Medidata Rave, Oracle InForm), IRT, eTMF and CTMS, as well as Microsoft Office.

  • Strong interpersonal, communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and effectively within cross-functional teams.

  • Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage priorities with an appropriate sense of urgency.

  • Fluent written and verbal English; an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.

  • Valid driver’s licence and ability to travel approximately 40–60%, depending on project assignment and the geographic location of investigative sites.

What We Offer

In addition, as an Alimentiv Employee, you’re also eligible for the following programs:

  • Education Reimbursement program for full-time employees
  • Monthly Cell Phone and Remote Work Allowance (dependent on role eligibility)
  • One time office setup allowance (can be used to purchase a scanner/printer, extra monitor, office furniture, etc.)
  • Working while visiting program – up to 4 weeks per year!
  • Flexible Summer Hours Program from May – September
  • Employee referral incentive – we know great people know other great people, and we think that warrants recognition!
  • Full-time employees also become beneficiaries of the Alimentiv Trust after one year of employment, and permanent members after 5 years of employment
  • Optional formal mentorship program (Alimentorship); country/region annual social events in person; leadership development programs for people leaders in accordance with your seniority; social committee and several other optional initiatives designed to support you in feeling like part of the Alimentiv team!

    • Additional benefits may be available depending on the country of employment and are subject to local policies and eligibility.

Our Services

  • End-to-end GI clinical trial services, from protocol design through submission support
  • Central medical imaging management and endoscopic reading
  • Precision medicine and biomarker solutions
  • Real-world evidence and clinical consulting
  • Histopathology and lab services through AcelaBio

How to Apply

To apply for this position, please submit your resume through the Alimentiv Careers Portal or via LinkedIn’s Easy Apply. Resumes must be submitted in English.

Equal Opportunity and Accessibility

Alimentiv is committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, ethnicity, national origin, religion or belief, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital or family status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Accommodations are available upon request for persons with disabilities throughout the recruitment and selection process. Requests can be directed to recruitment@alimentiv.com.

Compensation

Additionally:

  • Annual Bonus (Short Term Incentive Program) target = 8% of annual salary
  • A monthly stipend of 400 RON (pro-rated based on hours of work), to be paid with their regular payroll/added to their taxable income. This is intended to offset the business use of the employee’s communication costs (internet, VoIP, land line, etc.)
  • Monthly Cell phone stipend (RON 50)
  • A one time expense reimbursement of up to 500.00 (local currency) to purchase other office items such as a scanner/printer, an extra monitor, office furniture and supplies, etc.
  • Mileage reimbursement for travel

Additional Information

Stay Alert to Recruitment Scams

Alimentiv is aware of a continued increase in phishing scams, which use various methods of attack via email, text, voice and social media, including individuals posing as our recruiters and contacting candidates with fraudulent opportunities. Our hiring process always includes direct engagement with a recruiter or hiring manager, and we will never ask for sensitive personal information early in the process.

Official communication will only come from company email addresses containing "@alimentiv.com". If you are contacted about an open job at Alimentiv, please verify the domain of the sender's email address and confirm that you are being asked to apply on this website. If something doesn't feel right, we encourage you to verify before responding. If you believe you have been the victim of a phishing scam, please contact your local government cyber authority to report it.

The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.

Spotify runs on the tools we've built for ourselves. They help hundreds of teams ship every day to hundreds of millions of people around the world. Now, we're sharing them.

Spotify Technology brings our proven tools and services together for engineering organisations everywhere, from global enterprises to individual developers. As AI reshapes how software gets made, we're building on years of experience solving complex engineering challenges at scale.

Platform Design makes these powerful tools feel effortless. We shape the services, products and experiences used by Spotify's engineering teams and by developers around the world. We believe great design is a competitive advantage, and developer tools deserve the same care and craft as any consumer product.

As a Staff Product Designer, you'll combine product leadership with hands-on design and engineering. You'll shape the experience strategy for a key part of the Spotify Technology portfolio, establish a distinctive visual language, and turn internal tools into products customers love using. You'll work closely with product, engineering and marketing partners, reporting to the Spotify Technology Design Director.

What You'll Do

  • Lead complex design challenges from early exploration through to production, creating intuitive flows, interfaces, interactions and motion that make powerful developer tools easier to use.
  • Shape the visual language of Spotify Technology, bringing consistency, personality and craft across product experiences and brand touchpoints.
  • Transform tools built for Spotify's engineering teams into compelling commercial products that meet the needs of developers and enterprise customers.
  • Bring design to life in code, building and shipping high-quality front-end experiences with close attention to performance, accessibility and detail.
  • Set experience strategy across your product area, partnering with product and engineering leaders to influence priorities, guide decisions and shape the roadmap.
  • Use prototypes, storytelling and experimentation to make complex ideas tangible, build alignment and help teams navigate trade-offs.
  • Explore how generative AI and agentic tools can improve design and development workflows, while creating thoughtful experiences for products used by people and AI agents.
  • Raise the bar for design craft across the team, championing design systems, inclusive experiences and a culture of collaboration, feedback and continuous learning.

Who You Are

  • You have a strong background in product design, with experience shaping complex digital products and delivering high-quality visual and interaction design.
  • You're comfortable working across strategy and execution, setting a clear product direction while staying close to the details of design and delivery.
  • You can build and ship user interfaces using a modern front-end technology stack, and enjoy bringing your designs into production.
  • You understand how to create cohesive visual experiences across product and brand, with a thoughtful approach to interaction, motion and design systems.
  • You bring an understanding of developer tools, enterprise software or platform products, including the challenges of designing for technical audiences.
  • You use generative AI and agentic tools in your work, applying sound judgement about where they add value and where human expertise matters most.
  • You're comfortable navigating ambiguity, using research, data and customer insights to make informed decisions and solve complex problems.
  • You communicate ideas clearly, build trust across disciplines and influence product decisions through compelling design work and storytelling.
  • You care about helping others grow, welcome different perspectives and contribute to an inclusive, collaborative environment where great work can happen.

Where You'll Be

  • This role is based in London, UK or Stockholm, Sweden
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

Compensation

Additional Information

Role Description

As a Learning Experience Designer within Dropbox’s Customer Advocacy organization, you will create engaging, accessible, and effective learning experiences that help customers and administrators understand Dropbox products, complete key tasks, and achieve their goals.

You will design and maintain customer education across Dropbox Learn, product-launch education, learning paths, multimedia tutorials, and other self-service learning experiences. Working closely with cross-functional partners, you will translate complex product capabilities and customer needs into clear, actionable instruction.

You’ll combine instructional design principles, digital content production, and responsible AI-assisted workflows to develop scalable learning experiences. Your work will contribute to helping customers become more confident and successful with Dropbox products while improving the consistency, quality, and accessibility of customer education.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, publish, and maintain engaging, accessible, and accurate customer learning experiences across Dropbox products and education platforms.

  • Create and update web-based training, learning paths, product-launch education, tutorials, multimedia content, and other instructional resources.

  • Translate complex product workflows and customer needs into clear, task-oriented instruction with logical sequencing and actionable next steps.

  • Author, publish, and maintain learning content using Contentful and related content-management and learning-delivery platforms, including quality assurance and localization preparation.

  • Collaborate with Product, Product Marketing, Customer Advocacy, Support, subject-matter experts, and program managers to deliver education aligned with customer and business needs.

  • Responsibly leverage AI tools to support content drafting, storyboarding, synthesis, analysis, and production efficiency while validating outputs for accuracy, accessibility, instructional quality, and customer relevance.

  • Support continuous improvement of learning experiences through reusable templates, documented processes, customer feedback, performance insights, and content-quality standards.

Requirements

  • Experience creating or maintaining customer-facing learning, instructional, technical, enablement, or product education content.

  • Ability to translate complex product concepts and workflows into clear, structured, task-oriented instruction.

  • Experience using content-authoring, learning-management, or publishing platforms.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with subject-matter experts and cross-functional stakeholders to develop and refine instructional content.

  • Understanding of instructional quality principles, including accuracy, accessibility, consistency, and learner usability.

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple content deliverables, incorporate feedback, and meet deadlines.

  • Ability to learn and responsibly use AI-assisted tools to improve productivity while maintaining accountability for content quality and accuracy.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing web-based training, interactive learning, quick-start guides, video tutorials, or progressive learning paths.

  • Familiarity with Contentful, Articulate, Wistia, or comparable content and learning-production tools.

  • Experience supporting product launches, localization, or customer self-service education programs.

  • Experience using learning analytics, customer feedback, or content-performance data to inform improvements.

  • Experience collaborating with distributed teams in a technology or SaaS environment.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

  • Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

Compensation

€37.800—€51.200 EUR

Spotify’s mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity by giving a million creative artists the opportunity to live off their art and billions of fans the chance to enjoy and be passionate about these creators.

Data is a means to an end, and Spotify extracts value from data through application. The Data Platform Studio helps Spotify win by enabling the application of data in an intuitive and efficient way.

Data Platform is responsible for how data is collected, processed, stored, governed, and made available to the thousands of engineers, data scientists, analysts, and machine learning practitioners who build Spotify’s products. As AI agents increasingly generate code, write data pipelines, and power personalized user experiences, Data Platform sits at the center of one of the most important infrastructure domains at Spotify.

We're looking for a passionate Product Manager to join the team responsible for Spotify’s data catalogue, metadata, and data lineage capabilities. In this role, you'll own the strategy and roadmap for a critical part of Spotify's data ecosystem, helping users discover, understand, trust, and safely use data at scale. You'll work closely with engineers, designers, data scientists, and product teams across Spotify to make working with data faster, safer, and more intuitive.

What You'll Do

  • Develop and own the product strategy and roadmap for Spotify's data catalogue, metadata, and data lineage domain.
  • Diagnose and deeply understand the needs of Spotify's data community, including data engineers, data scientists, analysts, ML engineers, and increasingly AI agents.
  • Identify and prioritize the highest-impact problems to solve, balancing user needs, business priorities, platform requirements, and regulatory considerations.
  • Evaluate and deliver solutions through building, buying, or integrating third-party products and capabilities.
  • Define success metrics and KPIs that measure adoption, value creation, and business impact.
  • Build strong relationships with internal product, engineering, analytics, and data teams to understand workflows, gather feedback, and shape future platform investments.
  • Collaborate closely with engineering, design, and data science partners to deliver high-quality platform experiences.
  • Influence stakeholders across the Data Platform Studio and broader Spotify organization to align around product direction and priorities.
  • Help shape how Spotify approaches metadata, governance, discoverability, lineage, and trust in an increasingly AI-driven world.
  • Stay informed on industry trends across data platforms, developer tools, AI/ML infrastructure, analytics, and data governance.

Who You Are

  • You have 2+ years of Product Management experience, ideally working on platform products, developer tools, data infrastructure, analytics platforms, or data governance systems.
  • You have a technical foundation through a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related field, and/or prior experience in engineering or technical roles.
  • You are comfortable working with engineers and can engage in technical discussions while representing customer and business needs.
  • You are an excellent communicator and collaborator who can build alignment across teams with different priorities and levels of technical expertise.
  • You have strong systems-thinking skills and can connect workflows, platforms, users, and business outcomes.
  • You have empathy for people who work with data and understand the challenges they face every day.
  • You enjoy working through ambiguity, breaking down complex problems, and creating clarity for teams.
  • You are curious about how AI is transforming the data landscape and are excited to help shape that future.
  • You lead with humility, build trust through collaboration, and help teams move forward with focus and momentum.

Where You'll Be

  • This role is based in London or Stockholm
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

Compensation

Additional Information

jobs.jobDescription:
WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment.

We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato.

Base salary: $170,000 to $190,000. Plus an annual bonus paid as a flat amount rather than a percentage of base.

Launch Potato is about 200 people, profitable, and growing. The performance management system that got us here was built by our SVP of Talent, and he still runs it. That system becomes yours.

You're inheriting something that works. There's a levels framework, a rating scale, a calibration process, and managers who have been through several cycles. It got us to 200 people. Your job is deciding what carries forward and change-managing the rest, across an org that moves fast and adopts new processes.

We want someone who'll find the version that works and then hold it there while the company gets good at it.

If you want to own a function, make it extraordinary, and be judged on whether it actually got better, keep reading.

Why This Seat

  • Real ownership, immediately. Performance, total rewards, and compliance are yours to own rather than support. You'll defend a compensation number in front of a CFO who checks it.
  • An SVP who wants to hand this over. Not one who says that and then rewrites your deck. The explicit goal is that the HR function runs without him.
  • Executive reach by default. Calibration and leveling decisions live with the C-suite, and you present your own work. You won't spend year one convincing anyone that performance management matters.
  • Leverage is part of the mandate, not a side project. We are tech-first and AI-forward, which means we can run lean teams and do more with less. You'll push that further, build the tooling managers actually open, and make everything easier without taking substance out of it. Nobody will ask you to do it the slow way.

How This Team Is Led

From Kris Osborne, SVP of Talent.

I'll tell you what I want and what the constraints are and then get out of the way. I don't rewrite people's work. If I disagree with where you landed you'll hear it from me early, and if you still think you're right then push back, because I'd rather change my mind than have you go quiet and build something you don't believe in.

I ask before I decide. When something changes the shape of this team the people on it hear it from me first and they get a real say in it, not a heads up after it's done.

I care about the outcome and I'm not going to do your job for you. Bring me a problem and I'll work it with you, but I'm not going to take it off your plate and hand it back finished.

I'm hiring this seat because I want someone we can all learn from. Bring me a better answer than mine and I'll take it.

What You'll Bring

All required.

  • A full performance cycle you owned end to end, not supported. Owned more than once, at 150 people or more. Design, timeline, manager prep, calibration, rollout, retro.
  • Compensation and benefits you've owned. Band design, benchmarking methodology, benefits renewals, the annual comp cycle. You can defend a number to a CFO.
  • HR compliance as standing scope, not as a project. Multi-state registration, I-9, handbook, classification, postings. You've inherited a backlog and cleared it.
  • A people system that outlasted you. Built, adopted, and still recognizable two cycles later.
  • Leverage you built that people adopted. You've automated or rebuilt part of a people process so it ran faster, the quality held or improved, and the team actually used it. Adoption is the test here, the same way durability is the test above.
  • Experience taking a company our size to materially larger, on headcount or revenue, more than once. You know what breaks first at the next stage because you've watched it break.
  • Empowered your team to raise the bar. You have clear examples of coaching, mentoring, and growing a team that created extraordinary outcomes.

This is a player-coach seat. Managers here lead a team and deliver work personally, at every level.

Nice to Have

  • You have opinions about what performance management gets wrong, and specific examples of what you changed
  • You can tell a process problem from a manager-capability problem, and you fix the right one
  • You're the person who says the uncomfortable thing in a calibration room

What You'll Own

Performance management. The mid-year and annual cycles end to end: design, timeline, communication, execution. What the cycle needs to produce and what to cut. A timeline published early enough that managers plan around it. The retro after each one, and the judgment about when a change is warranted and when to leave it alone.

Total rewards. Band design and the benchmarking methodology behind it. Benefits renewals and the economics underneath them. The annual comp cycle, with leveling and pay kept connected.

Compliance. Multi-state registration, I-9, handbook, classification, postings. The current backlog, plus the escalation and coverage protocols that follow it.

Manager enablement. Preparing managers for real performance conversations, including the one where someone rated themselves higher than their manager did. The calibration process, including where two managers apply the same bar differently. Playbooks and self-service resources so a manager gets an answer without booking a meeting. Standing support for the roughly three dozen front-line managers who get it reactively today.

Leverage and tooling. Finding the parts of everything above that shouldn't be done by hand, and fixing them. Building what a manager will actually open rather than what looks good in a demo. Taking time out of the cycle while the conversations get better rather than thinner.

The team. An HR Business Partner and a Total Rewards and People Analytics lead. Both are strong at what they do and both have room to grow. You set their decision rights: where they decide, where they recommend, where it comes to you.

What Great Looks Like

In your first year:

  • The annual cycle ships on your timeline and you own it
  • Managers are calibrated before the cycle rather than corrected after it
  • Every person leaving a check-in has one clear thing to work on, and the conversation that produced it was a real one
  • The compliance backlog is closed and stays closed
  • The cycle costs managers less time than the year before, and the conversations are better rather than thinner
  • Your two reports hold more decision authority than they did at the start

This Isn't the Right Seat If

  • This would be your first Director-level people role
  • You lead with policy and risk. Compliance is required here and it isn't the center of the work
  • You want to redesign the cycle every year
  • You see tooling and automation as somebody else's job
  • You're looking for a recruiting role. Recruiting sits elsewhere in the function

Want to accelerate your career? Apply now!

jobs.jobDescription:
At ExtraHop, we’re on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise. We reveal what is happening in the very infrastructure that sustains businesses, lives, and communities, and ensure the integrity of networks, data, systems, and processes. Organizations rely on ExtraHop to provide visibility into the cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and network performance issues that evade their existing security and IT tools. With this insight, organizations can investigate smarter, stop threats faster, and keep operations running.

Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. If this sounds like a place you’d like to spend the next chapter of your career, we’d love to hear from you.

Position Summary
The Senior Accounting Manager is a key financial operations individual contributor role responsible for technical deferred commission accounting (ASC 340-40), global treasury administration, and international corporate governance across multiple foreign entities. Reporting to the Corporate Controller, this role serves as the subject matter expert for commission capitalization methodologies, global enterprise banking platforms, and foreign subsidiary statutory compliance. The ideal candidate combines technical accounting precision with strong operational execution to maintain internal controls, streamline global banking networks, and support scalable corporate expansion.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deferred Commissions Accounting
    • ASC 340-30 Close Execution: Manage monthly close processes; including portfolio-based accounting, performance obligation allocations, weighted-average rate calculations, and monthly accrual, deferral and amortization entries.
    • Rates Workbook & System Management: Prepare the Rates Workbook for bookings and commission reconciliations; maintain the deferred commissions dashboard and quarterly customer product life reports.
    • Audit Readiness & Automation: Write annual technical audit memos, lead quarterly customer-life evaluations, and manage audit deliverables. Partner with the Commission's team on comp plan updates. Advance process automation using AI tools (e.g. Claude) and commission engine automation modules.
  • Treasury & Global Banking Administration
    • Global Bank Account & Portal Governance: Serve as System Administrator for enterprise global banking portals and enterprise accounts; manage user access, entitlements, and portal permissions while ensuring compliance with internal governance standards, periodic Know Your Customer (KYC) reviews, mutual TLS (mTLS) security protocols, ACH fraud filters, concentration sweep structures, and payment processing modules.
    • Corporate Credit Card Administration: Administer the global credit card program, enforcing Merchant Category Code (MCC) policies, setting credit limits, investigating rejected authorizations, issuing cards, and serving as the primary accounting department cardholder.
    • Banking Partner Relationships: Act as the primary corporate contact for commercial banking partners, leading recurring relationship meetings and leveraging bank support networks to optimize service levels and resolve escalations.
  • International Subsidiary and Director Compliance
    • International Subsidiary Governance & Annual Compliance: Ensure our nine international entities remain in good standing by holding Annual General Meetings (AGMs), filing required statutory documents on time, and managing ongoing corporate governance requirements across foreign jurisdictions.
    • Entity Formation & Transitions: Partner with Legal and International Accounting to project-manage the legal and operational setup of new international subsidiaries; oversee the legal and administrative process for appointing, resigning, or undating foreign Directors.
    • Banking Compliance & Execution: Maintain KYC documentation for periodic compliance reviews with foreign banks and regulatory bodies; lead weekly international operational syncs to track global filing deadlines and maintain cross-functional accountability.
  • System Administration
    • Financial Close Management Administration: Serve as System Administrator for financial close management software, managing user onboarding, workflow optimization, and continuous process support in coordination with the internal accounting team.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business Administration.
  • 8+ years of progressive accounting experience in the tech industry (SaaS + Hardware), with direct expertise in ASC 340-40 (Cost of Obtaining Contracts with Customers) and ASC 606 (Revenue Recognition).
  • 3+ years of experience managing global banking portals (specifically Citibank / CitiDirect / CitiManager) and corporate credit card programs.
  • Proven background in international subsidiary management, board director changes, annual general meeting (AGM) filings, and global KYC/banking compliance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certified Public Accountant (CPA) or Certified Treasury Professional (CTP).
  • Treasury background with a strong Accounting/Finance foundation.
  • Corporate governance or international entity experience with a Paralegal or Law background.

Skills and Competencies

  • ERP & Financial Software: Advanced proficiency with ERP systems (e.g., NetSuite), financial close platforms (e.g. FloQast), and specialized commission engines (e.g. Xactly).
  • Banking Portals: Expert-level familiarity with Citibank portals (CitiDirect, CitiManager) and electronic file transfer/security protocols (mTLS, ACH filters).
  • Collaboration and teamwork: Works closely with recruiters, HRBPs, and leadership to support HR initiatives and work cooperatively with others within the organization and other cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Resilience: Performs exceptionally well in fast-paced, high-stress environments.
  • Reliability: Demonstrates predictable, reliable attendance and active engagement across all global responsibilities.

The salary range for this role is $120,000 - $135,000 + bonus + benefits.

ABOUT EXTRAHOP

ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution. By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments.

This comprehensive approach and market innovation have earned ExtraHop unique recognition as the only NDR vendor acknowledged as a leader by all major analyst firms, including the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant for Network Detection and Response™, the 2025 Forrester® Wave for Network Analysis and Visibility, the 2024 IDC® Marketscape for NDR, and the 2025 Gigamon® Radar Report for Network Detection and Response. Since 2007, ExtraHop has consistently helped organizations worldwide extract in-depth network telemetry and contextual insights, affirming its commitment to protecting and empowering the connected enterprise.

OUR VALUES

Our culture is rooted in our five Values. These set the expectations for how we work individually and collectively as a team.

Lead with Purpose: We are driven to deliver results that create a positive impact for our customers, partners, and colleagues.

Act with Integrity: We operate with transparency, authenticity, and always in the best interest of the company.

Find a Way: We are resourceful, tackle hard problems with a sense of urgency and ownership, and do what it takes to get the job done.

Innovate: We listen to customers, partners, and the market, and respectfully push boundaries and challenge the status quo.

Share Success: We run together, we win together. We value diverse perspectives, hold space for all voices, and achieve the best results as a team.

BENEFITS

Employees' wellbeing is top of mind for the ExtraHop team. Employees and their families will have the option to participate in the following benefits:

  • Health, Dental, and Vision Benefits
  • Flexible PTO, Sick Time Prorated Based on Date of Hire, and All Federal Holidays (US Only) + 3 Days of Paid Volunteer Time
  • Non-Commissioned Positions may be eligible to participate in the Annual Discretionary Bonus Plan
  • FSA and Dependent Care Accounts + EAP, where applicable
  • Educational Reimbursement
  • 401k with Employer Match or Pension where applicable
  • Pet Insurance (US Only)
  • Parental Leave (US Only)
  • Hybrid and Remote Work Model

Our people are our most important competitive advantage, leading the charge against cyber criminals. Join the fight today!

To learn more, visit our website or follow us on LinkedIn.

Interested in building your career at ExtraHop? Get future opportunities sent straight to your email.

The Role We Need:

PadSplit is hiring a Senior Product Designer to shape and improve experiences across our two-sided housing marketplace. Working on a growth-focused product team, you’ll tackle meaningful, complex problems for members and hosts, helping make it easier to find, access, and provide affordable housing. You’ll play a central role in designing intuitive, human, and scalable experiences that create measurable impact for our customers and business.

The Person We Are Looking For:

We’re looking for a senior-level designer who blends strong product intuition, systems thinking, deep empathy for users, and growth-minded experimentation. You thrive in complex problem spaces, move fluidly between big-picture strategy and pixel-level detail, and can clearly connect design decisions to customer needs and business outcomes. Above all, you are authentic, collaborative, and energized by solving meaningful problems with cross-functional teams.

Here’s What You’ll Be Doing Day-to-Day:

  • Own End-to-End Product Design – Lead design from early problem definition and exploration through prototyping, launch, and iteration across PadSplit’s marketplace.
  • Simplify Complex Experiences – Turn complicated workflows, rules, and marketplace dynamics into experiences that feel clear, intuitive, and approachable.
  • Conduct User Research – Interview, observe, and gather insights from members and hosts to deeply understand their needs and translate them into stronger products.
  • Drive Product Strategy – Partner with PMs to identify opportunities, shape solutions, and connect customer needs with measurable business outcomes.
  • Experiment & Iterate – Use data, customer feedback, prototypes, and experiments to test assumptions and continuously improve experiences.
  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally – Work closely with PMs, engineers, marketers, operations, and data partners to develop and deliver cohesive solutions.
  • Craft High-Quality UI – Build responsive, polished interfaces in Figma using thoughtful components, interaction patterns, and PadSplit’s design system.
  • Build AI-Infused Experiences – Prototype and design intelligent workflows and AI-powered features alongside our engineering, ML, and AI teams.

Here’s What You’ll Need to Be Successful:

  • Proven Experience – 4+ years designing digital products, ideally with complex acquisition funnels or marketplace environments.
  • Deep UX Skills – Strong research abilities and comfort engaging directly with users to uncover pain points and opportunities.
  • Business Fluency – Ability to connect design decisions to metrics, revenue, and real estate economics like rent, ROI, and occupancy.
  • Workflow Mastery – Experience designing multi-step processes, complex service environments, and edge-case-heavy workflows.
  • UI Excellence – Expertise in Figma and interaction design across web and mobile, with strong systems thinking and component reuse.
  • Data Orientation – Familiarity with A/B testing, experimentation frameworks, and interpreting both qual and quant insights.
  • AI Capability – Demonstrated experience designing AI-powered features and leveraging modern AI tools in your design practice.
  • Authentic Collaboration – A humble, kind, curious, and mission-driven approach that elevates the team and the user experience.

The Interview Process:

  • NO BOTS HERE: your resume will be reviewed by live humans from PeopleOps and the hiring manager.
  • If we’re interested, the next step would be a video screen with a member of the PeopleOps team for about thirty (30) minutes.
  • If warranted, the next steps would be a project review with the hiring manager (1) hour.
  • If warranted, the next step would be a design case study with key Design stakeholders at PadSplit for one (1) hour.
  • If warranted, the final step would be a design craft exercise with key stakeholders at PadSplit for one-and-a-half (1.5) hours.
  • If warranted, then we move to offer!

Compensation, Benefits, and Perks:

  • Fully remote position - we swear!
  • Competitive compensation package including an equity incentive plan and company-wide bonus opportunity
  • National medical, dental, and vision healthcare plans
  • Company provided life insurance policy
  • Optional accidental insurances, FSA, and DCFSA benefits
  • Unlimited paid-time (PTO) policy with eleven (11) company-observed holidays
  • 401(k) plan
  • Twelve (12) weeks of paid time off for both birth and non-birth parents
  • The opportunity to do what you love at a company that is at the forefront of solving the affordable housing crisis

Compensation

Compensation is based on the role's scope, national market benchmarks, the person's expertise and experience, and the impact of their contributions to our business goals.

Additional Information

Please note: Although the job posting says it's in Atlanta, Georgia, this is a fully remote position. This is a result of our Applicant Tracking System requiring a location to post the role on LinkedIn.

jobs.jobDescription:
At ExtraHop, we’re on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise. We reveal what is happening in the very infrastructure that sustains businesses, lives, and communities, and ensure the integrity of networks, data, systems, and processes. Organizations rely on ExtraHop to provide visibility into the cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and network performance issues that evade their existing security and IT tools. With this insight, organizations can investigate smarter, stop threats faster, and keep operations running.

Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. If this sounds like a place you’d like to spend the next chapter of your career, we’d love to hear from you.

Position Summary

Oversee ExtraHop eLearning programs, content, materials, and systems to drive a positive impact to revenue teams. With a bias for action, take initiative in addressing gaps in revenue performance through the creation of learning experiences that have a meaningful and positive impact on various sales processes and activities. This position will be a key member of the enablement team in setting standards for learning experiences and supporting the creation of best-practices and continuous improvement of eLearning content and materials

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and creation of learning experiences (eLeaning course, paths, guides, videos) for onboarding, ramping, readiness, and ongoing effectiveness and accreditation
  • Designing, creating, and publishing enablement experiences, including videos, guides, instructions, and lessons
  • Identify key performance indicators such as surveys, assessment scorecards, and feedback that demonstrate impact and identify areas of improvement
  • Manage and maintain internal eLearning Library (LMS), including full lifecycle of creation, updating, and archiving
  • Create and maintain a library of multimedia assets for use by other team members in building eLearning and live sessions
  • Analysis of needs, planning, building, and execution of programs
  • Collaborate with stakeholders and subject matter experts to ensure high-quality and impactful learning experiences through content, messaging, visuals, videos, and materials that support how sellers learn
  • Collaborate with teammates on best practices for enablement experiences, reusable templates, and internal guides for consistent quality and high-impact
  • Apply the latest sales enablement techniques and instructional design principles
  • Support additional projects focused on improving sales effectiveness
  • Work cooperatively with others within the organization and other cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Work well in fast-paced, high-stress environments.
  • Has predictable, reliable attendance.

Required Qualifications

  • 4 year college degree
  • 5 Years of experience in revenue enablement in creating eLearning, enablement programs, facilitating learning sessions, and driving positive impact to sales teams

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience planning, designing, and creating learning experiences for revenue-generating teams (SDR, BDR, sales, sales engineering)
  • Certifications or training in revenue enablement courses and programs

Skills and Competencies

  • Sales enablement platforms (HighSpot, Showpad, Seismic, and others)
  • Learning Management System experience (Lessonly, SkillJar, Docebo, and others)
  • Cloud office suites: Google Suite, Microsoft Office 365
  • Learning design tools
  • Basic video editing and production skills
  • Experience with sales methodologies, frameworks, and processes
  • Live facilitation experience (over Zoom/Teams or in-person classroom)

The salary range for this role is $135,000 - $149,000 + bonus + benefits

ABOUT EXTRAHOP

ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution. By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments.

This comprehensive approach and market innovation have earned ExtraHop unique recognition as the only NDR vendor acknowledged as a leader by all major analyst firms, including the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant for Network Detection and Response™, the 2025 Forrester® Wave for Network Analysis and Visibility, the 2024 IDC® Marketscape for NDR, and the 2025 Gigamon® Radar Report for Network Detection and Response. Since 2007, ExtraHop has consistently helped organizations worldwide extract in-depth network telemetry and contextual insights, affirming its commitment to protecting and empowering the connected enterprise.

OUR VALUES

Our culture is rooted in our five Values. These set the expectations for how we work individually and collectively as a team.

Lead with Purpose: We are driven to deliver results that create a positive impact for our customers, partners, and colleagues.

Act with Integrity: We operate with transparency, authenticity, and always in the best interest of the company.

Find a Way: We are resourceful, tackle hard problems with a sense of urgency and ownership, and do what it takes to get the job done.

Innovate: We listen to customers, partners, and the market, and respectfully push boundaries and challenge the status quo.

Share Success: We run together, we win together. We value diverse perspectives, hold space for all voices, and achieve the best results as a team.

BENEFITS

Employees' wellbeing is top of mind for the ExtraHop team. Employees and their families will have the option to participate in the following benefits:

  • Health, Dental, and Vision Benefits
  • Flexible PTO, Sick Time Prorated Based on Date of Hire, and All Federal Holidays (US Only) + 3 Days of Paid Volunteer Time
  • Non-Commissioned Positions may be eligible to participate in the Annual Discretionary Bonus Plan
  • FSA and Dependent Care Accounts + EAP, where applicable
  • Educational Reimbursement
  • 401k with Employer Match or Pension where applicable
  • Pet Insurance (US Only)
  • Parental Leave (US Only)
  • Hybrid and Remote Work Model

Our people are our most important competitive advantage, leading the charge against cyber criminals. Join the fight today!
